terminal_record.title: Internal Hold: Supplied 30% FBI Counterintelligence Purge Claim Is Unverified
terminal_record.description_short: A supplied Reuters headline reports later FBI ousters; it does not verify the frozen claim that 30% of counterintelligence staff were removed or replaced by loyalists.
terminal_record.description_medium: The frozen entry alleges that Kash Patel removed about 30% of FBI counterintelligence staff and replaced them with loyalists. The supplied correction says that percentage and motive are unsupported, and notes the frozen February 1 date precedes Patel’s confirmation. A Reuters headline about later FBI ousters is supplied as a separate lead, but its article text was not accessed and does not establish the numerical claim. This record remains on hold.
terminal_record.description_long: The frozen entry describes an alleged FBI personnel purge under Kash Patel, including a claim that roughly 30% of the counterintelligence division was removed or reassigned and that replacements were chosen for loyalty. The supplied correction identifies the percentage and categorical loyalty claim as unsupported, and flags that the stored February 1, 2025 date precedes Patel’s confirmation as FBI director. It says to hide this numerical record unless a source establishes the 30% figure; a separate entry may document specific, named leadership removals with dated sourcing. The packet also supplies a Reuters headline dated August 7, 2025, reporting that the FBI ousted an ex-acting director and other agents. That headline is a distinct later lead: the Reuters article text was inaccessible in prior research, and it does not establish the frozen counterintelligence figure, replacement motive, target case areas, or claimed capability gaps. Keep this record on hold. Do not treat the headline as corroboration or recast separate removals as this event.
